{{Top|leg}}
A '''pear''', or '''pear-fruit''', was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]. Variations included the [[hindian pear]], [[knobblypear]], and the [[Manta pear]]. [[Moonglow]] was a rare and expensive pearlike fruit found only in a single location in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
